parts.text:
Meeting: Refunds and order cancellations – Bakery Brasa (fictional data)
Date: 2026-10-19
Recording part: 1 of 1 (00:00–13:40)
Attendees: Ricardo Solano (Finance, stakeholder), Laura Peña (Operations), Julián Mora (Business analyst), Andrés Gil (Developer)

[00:00:15] Julián: Ricardo, Laura, today is about cancellations and refunds.
[00:00:30] Laura: Today a customer who cancels calls us and we refund by hand. It happens about ten times a week.
[00:01:10] Ricardo: I want customers to cancel from the app, but only before the bakery starts preparing the order.
[00:01:25] Laura: Preparing means the status "In the oven".
[00:01:40] Ricardo: Right. Before that they cancel and get the full refund automatically.
[00:02:30] Andrés: Automatic to the same card?
[00:02:36] Ricardo: Yes, the same card.
[00:03:20] Ricardo: And after "In the oven", a partial refund of fifty percent.
[00:03:35] Laura: No, that is not fair for a cake we have not decorated yet.
[00:03:50] Ricardo: You are right. Forget the fifty percent. After "In the oven" no cancellation from the app, they call us.
[00:04:05] Julián: So after "In the oven" the cancel option disappears. Confirmed?
[00:04:12] Ricardo: Confirmed.
[00:05:40] Laura: How long does the refund take to reach the card?
[00:05:48] Andrés: It depends on the payment provider. I do not know the time.
[00:06:00] Ricardo: Then find out. I want to tell customers a number of days.
[00:06:10] Andrés: I will ask the provider and report back.
[00:07:30] Ricardo: Also, every refund should appear in the daily cash close report.
[00:07:45] Julián: That belongs to the cash close work from last week; we note it as a dependency, not as new work.
[00:09:00] Laura: Gift cards, can they be refunded?
[00:09:08] Ricardo: Not now. Let's leave gift cards out.

meeting.title: Refunds and order cancellations – Julián Mora
meeting.goals: Agree how customers cancel orders and receive refunds, and identify the provider information needed to explain refund timing.
topics: Laura explained that customers currently call Operations to cancel; refunds are issued manually about ten times a week.
Customers may cancel in the app before the order reaches "In the oven" and receive a full automatic refund to the same card.
Ricardo withdrew the proposed 50% refund. Once the order is "In the oven" or later, the cancel option disappears and customers call Operations.
The time to reach the card is unknown and depends on the payment provider. Andrés agreed to ask the provider and report back so customers can be told a number of days.
Refunds should appear in the daily cash close report. Julián identified this as a dependency on existing work from last week, not a new backlog item.
Ricardo excluded gift cards from the current scope.
actions: **Unassigned:** Implement in-app cancellation before "In the oven", with a full automatic refund to the same card and no in-app cancellation once preparation starts.
**Andrés Gil:** Ask the payment provider how many days a refund takes to reach the card and report back.
decisions: Customers may cancel from the app only before the order reaches "In the oven".
Eligible cancellations trigger a full automatic refund to the same card.
From "In the oven" onward, the cancel option disappears; customers call Operations.
The proposed 50% refund after preparation starts was withdrawn.
Refund reporting belongs to existing daily cash close work and is a dependency, not new work.
Gift cards are excluded from the current scope.
related: Open question: How many days does a refund take to reach the card? Owner: Andrés Gil, asking the payment provider.
Dependency: Every refund must appear in the daily cash close report; this is covered by existing work from last week. Its ticket key is not specified.
Out of scope: Gift card refunds.
Withdrawn proposal: 50% partial refunds after "In the oven".
Open question: How cancellation and refund failures are handled is not specified; no failure behaviour was agreed.
Open question: The cancellation screen, option label and confirmation message are not specified.

items.title: Allow cancellation before preparation with a full automatic refund
items.desc: Customers can cancel from the app only before their order reaches "In the oven". Eligible cancellations trigger a full automatic refund to the same card. From "In the oven" onward, the cancel option disappears and customers call Operations. The proposed 50% refund was withdrawn; gift cards are excluded. Refund reporting is a dependency on the existing daily cash close work.
items.notes: 2026-10-19 — Allow cancellation before preparation: [Requested by: Ricardo Solano.] Suggested type: Story — customer-visible cancellation and refund behaviour. Implementation owner and phase were not assigned. The 50% refund proposal was withdrawn. Gift cards are out of scope.
items.ctx: Customers currently call Operations to cancel orders, and refunds are issued manually about ten times a week. Finance agreed to allow eligible cancellations from the app, with preparation starting at "In the oven".
items.story: As a customer, I want to cancel my order from the app before preparation starts and receive a full refund to the same card, so that I do not have to call Operations for an eligible cancellation.
ac: A customer cancels an order from the app before its status reaches "In the oven"
the order is cancelled and a full refund is issued automatically to the same card
An order has reached "In the oven" or a later status
the cancel option is not shown and the order cannot be cancelled from the app
items.validation: AC1–AC2 are specific, observable and traceable to 00:01:10–00:02:36 and 00:03:50–00:04:12. They cover the agreed in-app cancellation, full automatic refund to the same card and cancellation restriction. No edge case, provider timing, failure handling or partial refund rule was invented; the source supports happy-path and negative cases only.
items.refs: After "In the oven", customers call Operations; no support number or UI message was specified. Dependency: refund entries belong to existing daily cash close work (00:07:30–00:07:45); no ticket key was provided. Gift cards are out of scope. The 50% partial-refund proposal was withdrawn. Open question (Andrés Gil): provider settlement time in days. Cancellation controls, confirmation text and failure handling were not specified.

items.title: Determine how many days refunds take to reach the card
items.desc: Andrés Gil will ask the payment provider how many days refunds take to reach the card and report back, so Ricardo Solano can communicate a time to customers. The meeting did not establish a refund settlement time.
